from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = ROOT.parent / 'v83-native-receipt-union-r1/source'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_workflow_process',
    SOURCE / 'review-evidence/hia-native-rewrite-20261111/workflow_process.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_')}
environment['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
receipt = module.run_workflow_step([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'run_private_vm.py')],
    cwd=SOURCE, env=environment, stdout_path=ROOT / 'stdout.log', stderr_path=ROOT / 'stderr.log',
    receipt_path=ROOT / 'supervisor.json', seconds=1800)
print(json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt['status'] == 'WORKFLOW_STEP_COMPLETED' else 1)
